plan.title: Scholarship Scheme Progress
plan.subtitle: District-wise pending cases

panels.title: Total pending cases
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE Status = 'Pending'

panels.title: Pending cases by district
panels.sql: SELECT District, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE Status = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Pending cases by district
panels.sql: SELECT District, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE Status = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Pending cases by scheme
panels.sql: SELECT Name of scheme, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE Status = 'Pending' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
